text: Linear Algebra I: Practice Midterm October 10, 2025 Problem 1. Suppose W is a subspace of V and v1 + W, . . . , vm + W is a basis of V /W . Let w1, . . . , wn be a basis of W . Show that v1, . . . , vm, w1, . . . , wn is a basis of V . Problem 2. Let V be a finite dimensional vector space. Let φ ∈ V ∗ be nonzero. Show that there exists v ∈ V with φ(v) = 1 and V = span{v} ⊕ ker φ. Problem 3. Let V be a two-dimensional vector space over R and T : V → V a linear transformation. Suppose that β = (v1, v2) and γ = (w1, w2) are two bases in V such that w1 = v1 + v2, w2 = v1 + 2v2. Find [T ]β β if [T ] γ γ = ( 2 −1 3 1 ) . Problem 4. Let V be the subspace of C(R) given by span(e3x cos x, e3x sin x). Consider the linear map L : V → C(R) defined by L(f ) = f ′ − f , where the prime denotes differentiation with respect to x. (i) Show that e3x cos x, e3x sin x are linearly independent. (ii) Show that the image of L is in V , that is im L ⊂ V . (iii) Let β = (e3x cos x, e3x sin x), find [L]β β. (iv) Find ker L and im L. (v) Find a solution to the differential equation f ′ − f = 2e3x cos x. Problem 5. Consider the matrix A =   2 4 1 −3 −6 2 1 2 1   . (i) Find all x ∈ R3 such that Ax =   3 −1 2  . (ii) Let V ⊂ R3 be the set of vectors b ∈ R3 such that the system Ax = b is solvable. Find a basis for V . 1
